title: RoutePolicy v1
description: The routing settings of the shortest-path plugin that are not facts about the account. Optional fields default to the behaviour of clients that omit them.

banking.description: Whether routes may withdraw items from the bank. avoid only banks when it saves a lot of time.

resources.description: How consumable teleports (tablets, charged jewellery, whistles) are treated. permanent-only never uses them.

avoidedTransportTypes.description: Transport types the route must not use. TELEPORTATION_ITEM also disables teleport boxes.

teleportItems.description: owned uses only the account's items; any assumes every teleport item is available.

currencyThreshold.description: The most coins, trading sticks, ecto-tokens or warrior guild tokens spent on one transport. Omit for no limit.

transportThresholds.description: How many ticks a transport type must save over the alternatives to be used.

declaredUnlocks.description: Account state the game does not report to the plugin, declared without verification.
